recentItems.title: How Long Is Silent Hill: Townfall?
recentItems.description: Silent Hill: Townfall has finally arrived, ready to provide you with hours and hours of survival horror fun, in which you can test yourself as Simon Ordell through the spooky streets of St. Amelia. Like previous Silent Hill entries, Townfall boasts a handful of endings to obtain, but just how long is it? Here, we'll let you know exactly how many hours it took different members of the IGN team to finish the game, and what they prioritised doing with that time.

recentItems.title: True Street Fighter fans will recognize these moves
Bungie Is 'Absolutely Not Done With Destiny,' Teases More Content - IGN Daily Fix
recentItems.description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Bungie dropped a surprise video expressing their thanks to fans for being honest about the future of Destiny. Earlier this year, Bungie made the decision to stop content development for Destiny 2, effectively ending new updates the game after nearly 10 years. But according to Bungie, they're not done yet, and promise they have more stories to tell in that universe. Bungie is also teasing the return of old content removed from Destiny 2. In other news, Final Fantasy 7 Revelation can be a very long game—about 100 hours—if you try and do _everything_. And finally, Zach Creggers adaptation of Resident Evil had a scary good debut weekend.

recentItems.title: Minecraft Dungeons 2 - Official Opening Cinematic
recentItems.description: Here's a look at the Opening Cinematic for Minecraft Dugeons 2, an action-adventure RPG developed by Mojang Studios. Players can enjoy the introduction to the game as they prepare to face all-manner of enemies, explore diverse biomes, and head straight into the unknown. Minecraft Dungeons 2 is launching on September 29 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Game Pass, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Xbox Cloud and Steam).

recentItems.title: Stronghold 4 - Official Features Trailer
recentItems.description:
Take a look at the Features Trailer for Stronghold 4, a city-building strategy simulation game developed by Firefly Studios. Players can get the rundown on key features to engage with, including 14 battlefields to wage upon, 8 enemy lords to dispatch, and more. Stronghold 4 is coming soon to PC (Steam).

recentItems.title: Ninja Scroll - Official 4K Theatrical Re-Release Clip (English Subtitles)
recentItems.description:
Check out the 4K Theatrical Re-Release Clip for Ninja Scroll, an anime action film distributed by Iconic Events. Relive the 1993 samurai classic with enhanced 4K visuals for Ninja Scroll, in theaters on October 4,5, & 7.

A vagabond swordsman is aided by a kunoichi and a spy in battling a demonic clan of killers led by a ghost from his past, who are bent on overthrowing the Tokugawa Shogunate. 

Ninja Scroll is directed and written by Yoshiaki Kawajiri. Ninja Scroll returns to theaters on October 4,5, & 7.

recentItems.title: Ravenswatch - Official Kintaro Teaser Trailer
recentItems.description:
Don't miss the Kintaro Teaser Trailer for Ravenswatch, a co-op action roguelike developed by Passtech Games. Players can check out the latest hero with Kintaro joining the fight alongside his bear to add pressure to any combat engagement. Fight as Kintaro in Ravenswatch on October 12 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).

recentItems.title: Arena Breakout: Infinite - Official Season 7: Utopia Launch Trailer
recentItems.description:
Take a look at the Season 7: Utopia Launch Trailer for Arena Breakout: Infinite, a free-to-play first-person extraction shooter developed by Morefun Studios. Players can dive into the new content as part of Season 7's launch, with balance adjustments, nerfs to flashlights, new Zombie modes, and more to explore. Season 7: Utopia is available now for Arena Breakout: Infinite for PC (Steam).
